abstract: This is a descriptive epidemiologic report based on over 3000 incident testicular cancer cases occurring among residents of the US and Puerto Rico, as reported to the Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results (SEER) program of the National Cancer Institute for the years 1973 through 1982. White men had significantly higher incidence rates than their New Mexico Hispanic, black, and Puerto Rican Hispanic counterparts with weighted risk ratios of 1.36, 4.62, and 4.80, respectively. Ethnic differences in incidence were least evident at the extremes of age. Although the distribution of histologic subtypes did not differ across ethnic strata, morphologic expression was related to age at diagnosis. There was a predominance of right-sided tumor involvement in each ethnic group in childhood (less than 15 years of age), but not in the oldest age categories or among tumors presenting in cryptorchid testes. Never married men appeared to be at greater risk of developing nonseminoma testicular cancer than their married counterparts. Analysis of ethnic secular trends, using data from comparable geographic areas, showed a consistent increase in incidence among young men for all three ethnic groups. The contrast between the rate differences and the homogeneity of descriptive parameters across ethnic strata suggest the impact of quantitative rather than qualitative differences in environmental etiology.
abstract_ja: 本記述的疫学研究は、SEER(Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results)プログラムに報告された、1973年から1982年に米国およびプエルトリコ在住者で発生した3000例を超える精巣がん症例に基づく。白人男性の罹患率は、ニューメキシコ州のヒスパニック系、黒人、プエルトリコのヒスパニック系の男性よりも有意に高く、重み付けされたリスク比はそれぞれ1.36、4.62、4.80であった。民族間の罹患率の差は、年齢の両端で最も目立たなかった。組織型の分布は民族集団間で差はなかったが、形態学的な表現は診断時の年齢と関連していた。小児(15歳未満)では右側の腫瘍が優勢であったが、最高齢の年齢層や停留精巣に生じた腫瘍では右側優位は認められなかった。未婚男性は、既婚男性に比べて非セミノーマ型精巣がんを発症するリスクが高いと考えられた。解析可能な地域における民族別の経時的傾向では、3つの民族集団すべてで若年男性の罹患率が一貫して上昇していた。罹患率の差と、民族集団間での記述的パラメータの均一性との対比は、環境要因の病因における量的差異の影響を示唆する。
